premise: Fox doesn't believe Frog was once a tiny wiggly tadpole; Beaver shows him the tadpoles in the pond.
inspiration: Kipling's Just So stories (how the animal got its legs), told truly: the doubter is shown, not told, and the proof is right there in the pond.
lesson: Everyone starts small and changes as they grow.
learning: Frogs start life as tadpoles swimming in water

en-US.title: Frog Was a Tadpole
en-US.text: {frog:face happy} [excited] I used to be a tadpole, said {frog:enter} Frog {frog:pulse}. {fox:face surprised} [laughs] A what? said {fox:enter} Fox {fox:wobble}. You're joking! A tiny wiggly thing with a tail, said Frog, swimming in the pond. No legs at all! {fox:face normal} {fox:shake 0.4} Fox didn't believe a word. Frogs have legs, he said. Big springy ones. So {beaver:enter} Beaver {beaver:hop} took them to the edge of the pond. [whispers] Look closely, he said. {sfx:water solo} There in the water were lots of little black tadpoles, wiggle, wiggle, some with tiny back legs just starting to grow. {fox:face surprised} [gasps] They'll be frogs one day, said Beaver. Fox {fox:sparkle} stared and stared. Then Frog {frog:live} sprang up, did a backflip onto her lily pad, and caught a fly. Snap! {fox:face happy} {fox:hop} [giggles] See? she said. Those legs were worth the wait.

es-ES.title: Rana fue renacuajo
es-ES.text: {frog:face happy} [excited] Yo antes era un renacuajo, dijo {frog:enter} Rana {frog:pulse}. {fox:face surprised} [laughs] ¿Un qué?, dijo {fox:enter} Zorro {fox:wobble}. ¡Estás de broma! Una cosita pequeña que se menea, con cola, dijo Rana, nadando en la charca. ¡Sin patas! {fox:face normal} {fox:shake 0.4} Zorro no se creía ni una palabra. Las ranas tienen patas, dijo. Grandes y saltarinas. Así que {beaver:enter} Castor {beaver:hop} los llevó a la orilla de la charca. [whispers] Mirad bien, dijo. {sfx:water solo} Allí, en el agua, había un montón de renacuajos negritos, meneo, meneo, algunos con unas patitas traseras que empezaban a crecer. {fox:face surprised} [gasps] Un día serán ranas, dijo Castor. Zorro {fox:sparkle} miraba y miraba. Entonces Rana {frog:live} dio un brinco, una voltereta hasta su hoja de nenúfar, y atrapó una mosca. ¡Zas! {fox:face happy} {fox:hop} [giggles] ¿Lo ves?, dijo. Mereció la pena esperar a tener estas patas.
